definition: to clean between your teeth with thin thread
translation: xỉa răng bằng chỉ nha khoa
exampleSentence: My dentist says I should floss my teeth every day.
exampleTranslation: Nha sĩ bảo tôi nên dùng chỉ nha khoa mỗi ngày.

definition: to wash your mouth with water and spit it out
exampleSentence: Rinse your mouth after you brush.
exampleTranslation: Hãy súc miệng sau khi đánh răng.

definition: to cut your beard a little to keep it neat
exampleSentence: He trims his beard once a week.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy tỉa râu mỗi tuần một lần.

definition: to make your fingernails or toenails shorter
translation: cắt móng tay, cắt móng chân
exampleSentence: I cut my nails on Sundays.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cắt móng tay vào các Chủ nhật.

definition: to make your nails smooth with a small tool
exampleSentence: She sat filing her nails.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy ngồi giũa móng tay.

definition: to put coloured polish on your nails
exampleSentence: I paint my nails red.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sơn móng tay màu đỏ.

definition: to dry your hair with a hairdryer
exampleSentence: She blow-dries her hair after washing it.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy sấy tóc sau khi gội.

definition: to arrange your hair in a particular way
exampleSentence: I style my hair before I go to work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi tạo kiểu tóc trước khi đi làm.

definition: to change the colour of your hair with a special liquid
exampleSentence: She dyed her hair red.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy nhuộm tóc màu đỏ.

definition: to have someone cut your hair
exampleSentence: I haven't had a haircut for months.
exampleTranslation: Đã nhiều tháng rồi tôi chưa cắt tóc.

definition: to wash your body standing under running water
exampleSentence: I had a shower this morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nay tôi đã tắm.

definition: to put a product under your arms to stop bad smells
exampleSentence: I use deodorant every day.
exampleTranslation: Ngày nào tôi cũng dùng lăn khử mùi.

definition: to put a nice-smelling liquid on your skin or clothes
exampleSentence: She sprays a little perfume on her wrists.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy xịt một chút nước hoa lên cổ tay.

definition: to put small plastic lenses in your eyes to see better
exampleSentence: I wear contact lenses instead of glasses.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đeo kính áp tròng thay vì kính gọng.

definition: to wipe the dirt from your glasses
exampleSentence: I clean my glasses with a soft cloth.
exampleTranslation: Tôi lau kính bằng một miếng vải mềm.

definition: to push air out of your nose into a tissue
exampleSentence: He blew his nose and sneezed.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy xì mũi rồi hắt hơi.

definition: to remove water from your hands with a towel
exampleSentence: She dried her hands on a towel.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy lau khô tay bằng khăn.

definition: to go to the toilet
translation: đi vệ sinh, dùng nhà vệ sinh
exampleSentence: May I use the toilet, please?
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi dùng nhà vệ sinh được không?

definition: to make water wash the toilet clean
exampleSentence: Please flush the toilet after you use it.
exampleTranslation: Xin hãy xả nước bồn cầu sau khi dùng.

definition: to colour your lips with a stick of make-up
exampleSentence: She put on lipstick before the party.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy tô son trước bữa tiệc.

definition: to take make-up off your face
exampleSentence: I remove my makeup before bed.
exampleTranslation: Tôi tẩy trang trước khi đi ngủ.

definition: to clean or dry your face with a cloth
exampleSentence: Wipe your face. There is chocolate on it.
exampleTranslation: Lau mặt đi. Mặt con dính sô-cô-la kìa.

definition: to spread cream on your skin
exampleSentence: Apply the cream twice a day.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thoa kem hai lần mỗi ngày.

definition: to clean your feet with water
exampleSentence: Wash your feet before you get into bed.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rửa chân trước khi lên giường.
